claim: V11 §4.1 (l. 4834–4840) cites J-V11.113 for its whole delete refusal. Since round 3 that refusal includes "a table's named row (V11 §2.1's settings form — `settings`, `structure`, `festival.staging`'s `fallback` —, whose cells its readers read with no fallback)". This round, §7.1's row (base l. 10586; VV1112-r3-04) and V09's `refuse.table.required` row (l. 2006; VV1112-r3-05) were conformed to it. J-V11.113 (l. 5280) still records four cases — "what readers fall back to — a table's `defaultRow`, an `allowFallback` target, a totality rule's only cover, the last row of a table not `mayEmpty`". It is the third restatement of the same rule, and the sweep missed it. A stale record; nothing built changes.
required_change: J-V11.113: "chose to refuse a row delete that would remove what readers fall back to — a table's `defaultRow`, an `allowFallback` target, a totality rule's only cover, the last row of a table not `mayEmpty` —" → "chose to refuse a row delete that would remove what readers fall back to or need — a table's `defaultRow`, an `allowFallback` target, a totality rule's only cover, a table's named row (V11 §2.1's settings form), the last row of a table not `mayEmpty` —"; the rest of the record stands.
